beats.say: Why not inner join?
Inner join only returns matched orders, hides missing payments, and loses critical data!
Left join returns all completed orders, shows missing payments as null, and reveals data quality issues!
NULL payment means order has no successful payment
Multiple payments might indicate data issues
Exact match is ideal case
COALESCE handles NULL payments gracefully
LEFT JOIN from orders reveals missing payments
Reconciliation produces four possible statuses
Order 2001 is perfect, 2002 is short, 2004 is missing!
